# omfx documentation

> Oh My Fx (`omfx`) is a coding agent CLI: parse gate, one-shot LSP, hybrid search, effort `auto`, ARC compaction, memory and board, credential-aware models, and local credentials — no gateway of its own.

Use the Markdown pages below for installation, configuration, and reference.

## Install and run

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yabuku-xD/omfx/main/install.sh | sh
omfx update --check
omfx
omfx ask "explain this repository"
```

## Getting started

- [Quick start](index.md): Install, sign in, and learn the commands worth knowing.
- [Installation](getting-started/installation.md): Install, build, verify, and `omfx update`.
- [Authentication](getting-started/authentication.md): Providers, OAuth, and API keys.

## Using omfx

- [CLI commands](using/cli.md): Top-level commands and global flags.
- [Slash commands](using/slash-commands.md): Commands inside the interactive session.
- [Sessions](using/sessions.md): Save, resume, rewind, fork, and compact.
- [Troubleshooting](using/troubleshooting.md): Install, auth, diagnostics, and terminal issues.

## Configure

- [Configuration](configure/configuration.md): Settings files and preferences.
- [Models](configure/models.md): Model list, effort, and last-used persistence.
- [Permissions](configure/permissions.md): Ask, plan, yolo, allowlist, sandbox.

## Capabilities

- [Tools](capabilities/tools.md): Built-in agent tools, parse gate, hybrid search, LSP.
- [Web search](capabilities/web-search.md): `/web` backends and fallback order.
- [Skills](capabilities/skills.md): Discovered slash skills and stacking.
- [MCP](capabilities/mcp.md): Model Context Protocol servers.
- [Peers and board](capabilities/peers.md): Teammates, board, memory, playbook.
- [IDE](capabilities/ide.md): Open the workspace in an external editor.
- [Plugins](capabilities/plugins.md): Claude-compatible marketplaces.
